title: Founder idea
description: One idea of the founder's (founders/<handle>/ideas/<id>.json), owned by the founder, not a venture. It exists before any venture and outlives one; a venture cites the idea it grew from. The text is the founder's, verbatim; an agent never rewrites it.

text.description: The idea in the founder's own words

source.description: Where it was said: a conversation, a note, a voice memo

status.description: in-venture = a venture grew from it; dropped needs a note

ventures.description: Venture folders that cite this idea
